Definition: properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny)
BiblicalUsage: 1) spring, fountain; 1a) spring; 1a1) of source of life, joy, purification (fig.); 1b) of the eye (fig.); 1c) source (of menstruous blood); 1d) flow (of blood after child birth)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
